name: Product card
summary: A card for one product: a photo, category, name, one-line description, rating, price with the old price struck out, an Add to bag button and a save toggle.
use: in a store or marketplace grid
a11y: Add to bag and save are toggle buttons with aria-pressed; the rating and the old price are read as words ("Rated 4.6 out of 5", "was $198"), and the photo has alt text.
